basis: Neither depth6 nor depth7 attains 0.90 on any of the 1421 fresh train-side queries. Thus forced 7->9->10 and 6->9->10 have exactly the same 1265 oracle successes and final context as 9->10, while adding 547.50 or 472.83 Target tokens/request respectively.
scope: Applies to these fixed forced multi-probe schedules and target 0.90. It does not prove every selective or alternative-depth observation is useless.
